definitions.gloss: road construction; road work; road repairs
definitions.explanation: Construction or maintenance work being done on a road. Includes repaving, pipe installation, bridge repairs, and other infrastructure work that affects traffic.

examples.japanese: {道路工事|どうろこうじ}で{渋滞|じゅうたい}している。
examples.english: There's a traffic jam due to road work.

examples.japanese: この{先|さき}、{道路工事|どうろこうじ}のため{片側|かたがわ}{通行|つうこう}です。
examples.english: Ahead, traffic is one-way only due to road work.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}に{道路工事|どうろこうじ}の{音|おと}がうるさくて{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: The noise from road construction at night was so loud that I couldn't sleep.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in daily life. Road work is frequent in Japanese cities, often done at night to minimize traffic disruption. Signs saying {道路工事|どうろこうじ}{中|ちゅう} (road work in progress) are ubiquitous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道路工事|どうろこうじ}{中|ちゅう} (road work in progress)
- {道路工事|どうろこうじ}のため{通行止|つうこうど}め (road closed for construction)
- {道路工事|どうろこうじ}{現場|げんば} (road construction site)
